raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The silver_transactions filter `ingest_ts - txn_ts <= 26 HOUR` silently drops POSTED transactions that arrive late. Since batch 3, a large share of each batch has been delivered more than 26 hours after txn_ts, and the sampled rows show lags of about 67 to 68 hours. The filter is the only thing that explains the shortfall, because REVERSED rows are only about 4% of the data. txn_id is unique, so removing the filter cannot introduce duplicates.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.7, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
